snippet.title: Pine Creek - Official Teaser Trailer | '80s Sci-Fi Alien Abduction Survival Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Pine Creek on Steam 🛸
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430740/Pine_Creek

A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.

🔔 Join our community for updates, behind-the-scenes content, and sneak peeks:

🗣️ Socials: https://linktr.ee/dreadmith
🌐 Website: https://www.dreadmith.com

Developed by DREADMITH Games™
Powered by Unreal Engine

If you enjoy horror games like Resident Evil, Outlast, Alien: Isolation, Greyhill Incident and They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror, or love the 80s classic sci-fi and horror movies or series like Stranger Things and X-Files, then PINE CREEK™ is for you.
